overclaims: As context, OpenRouter measured that users moving to OpenAI's newest flagship, GPT-5.5, paid 49% to 92% more than with GPT-5.4.
The figures are unaudited press estimates covering all models, and per-token prices for older models kept falling.
checks.note: OpenRouter measured average billed cost per million OpenRouter tokens by prompt-size bucket in a defined switcher cohort, comparing April 21–23 with April 25–28, 2026. The payload omits that normalization and scope, implying a broader spending comparison. The packet mentions an older-model price cut in June 2025; it does not establish that older-model prices 'kept falling'.
